items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played with Walter Bishop and Elvin, and that was beautiful, you know.

ctx.x: Anyways, I played with Walter Bishop and Elvin, and that was beautiful, you know. So I had all these great blessings just when I was getting to New York. And then Chico’s stuff started working a little more. I got a call from a guy named Harry Colomby who was the manager for Monk.
